title: Say it. Shape it.
summary: An original chat-driven design recording becomes a focused software promo with exact typography, readable UI crops, and an editable camera plan.

inputs.label: Original Forma recording
inputs.description: A 12-second original scripted fixture: a chat request creates a garden landing page and a follow-up warms its palette. This fictional interface does not claim shipping-product behavior.

inputs.label: Exact copy and focus hints
inputs.description: Supplied product name, exact titles, colors, timestamp hints, and named source regions. The workflow preserves this wording and the actual recording pixels.

stages.label: Inspect the recording
stages.description: Validate the source and sample its chronology before any paid call.

stages.label: Save an editable camera plan
stages.description: An image-aware structured model proposes the timing and crop sequence. This selected proposal was used without manual changes; authored focus hints and regions guide it.

stages.label: Render exact source pixels
stages.description: Local typography and clean cuts frame the supplied recording. Strict full-file decoding validates delivery; the frozen production run reused the exact cached model proposal at $0.

stages.label: Independent sampled review
stages.description: A different model accepted all eight criteria on timestamped frames, the full-size poster, exact-copy brief, and report.

limitations: This original fictional recording is a separate fixture generator; callers supply prepared, rights-cleared footage of their own product.
One silent 1920×1080 composition, with even source retiming. Narration, sound design, pause removal, device mockups, and larger multishot edits belong to the caller.
Independent review covers sampled visual evidence and a static poster, not continuous motion or listening. Source and final MP4 decoding are structural checks.
The same workflow also produced a separately reviewed 19-second original poster-design variant. Two inputs are a small compatibility sample, not a general success rate.
